title: ETH-WCMK: a formally verified core and a SHACL-validated ontology for auditing delegated ethical agency
description: ETH-WCMK models an ethical judgement about a delegated AI agent as a computation. The repository contains the arithmetic core with 44 invariants (69 tests), a 33-facet registry, a tetrahedral relation geometry, an RDF/SHACL ontology validated against a 220,400-confrontation corpus, and the manifests that tie every published number to a byte-identical artefact. Corpora are published as compressed release assets and mirrored here for persistent citation.
